item.title: San Angelo Man Arrested for Uploading Lewd Images of Children on Snapchat
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A San Angelo man has been arrested for allegedly uploading and sharing child pornography on Snapchat.Enrique Ramirez, 27, was charged with possession of child pornography less than 100 visual depictions. Learn More Here.

item.title: Brady ISD Drops School Photo Company Due to Epstein Rumors
item.description: BRADY, TX — Brady ISD announced Tuesday that it will no longer use Lifetouch for its school photos due to rumors that the business is associated with late convicted child sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.Numerous other schools around the country have also recently dropped the photo company’s service. Learn More Here.

item.title: Former Wall Standout Williams Named LSC Athlete of the Week
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Angelo State’s Kamryn Williams was named the Lone Star Conference Indoor Track and Field Athlete of the Week for her performance this past weekend at the Jarvis Scott Open in Lubbock. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 11 Angelo State's Austin Beck Named LSC Hitter of the Week
item.description: RICHARDSON, TX — Angelo State outfielder Austin Beck was named the Lone Star Conference Hitter of the Week on Tuesday after a dominant performance at the plate during the Rams’ road trip to Alpine against Sul Ross State last weekend.Beck, a redshirt senior from Allen, Texas, batted .625 with a .700 on-base percentage and a 1.063 slugging percentage for a 1.763 OPS. He accounted for 40% of Angelo State’s run production, driving in 10 runs while scoring 12 times. Learn More Here.

item.title: Texas Raises Emergency Operations Level as Wildfire Risk Grows
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — Gov. Greg Abbott on Tuesday ordered the Texas Division of Emergency Management to raise the readiness level of the State Operations Center to Level II, an escalated response posture, as critical wildfire conditions develop across parts of West Texas and the High Plains. Learn More Here.

item.title: Rap Legend Paul Wall to Headline YMCA Benefit Concert in San Angelo
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Rap legend Paul Wall is scheduled to perform in San Angelo this summer as part of a benefit concert for the YMCA.Wall and other rappers will perform with the San Angelo Community Orchestra at 7:30 p.m. Friday, June 5, 2026 at the Murphey Performance Hall, 72 W. College Ave. Learn More Here.

item.title: Robert Lee Clinches Playoff Spot With Win Over Garden City
item.description: ROBERT LEE, TX — Through all of the ups and downs of a wild district schedule, the Robert Lee Steers played their best basketball when it mattered most.The Steers put together a clutch 9-0 run late Tuesday against Garden City to pull away for a 48-39 win that locked up the last playoff spot in District 11-1A. Learn More Here.

item.title: Central Cruises Past Odessa High, Claims Outright District Championship
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — For the first time in 14 years, the Central Bobcats stand alone atop District 2-6A as champions. The Bobcats had one final step to claim the district title, and did so decisively. Central flattened Odessa High on Tuesday night, 61-32. Learn More Here.
